accounts.name: Workplace Rights Watch
accounts.mission: Empowering corporate employees and contractors against unlawful wage withholding, delayed Full & Final settlements, fake PIPs, and toxic employer harassment with factual legal knowledge.
tone_rules: Empathetic, firm, investigative, fearless yet legally cautious
Never demean or mock victims; prioritize victim empowerment and dignity
Use active, assertive language with precise statutory references
forbidden_terms: Casual slang or comedic meme punchlines on serious harassment
mandatory_disclaimers: Disclaimer: This post is for educational and rights awareness purposes only. Consult a licensed labor advocate for personal disputes.

audience_cohorts.name: Junior Tech & Freshers (0-3 yrs)
core_fears: Loss of experience certificate / relieving letter
Negative background verification (BGV) threats
Illegal training bond intimidation
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Protective, reassuring, demystifying corporate HR myths, plain language

audience_cohorts.name: Mid-to-Senior Professionals (4-12 yrs)
core_fears: Withheld Full & Final (FnF) settlements beyond 30 days
Arbitrary termination via weaponized PIPs
Severance and notice pay disputes with family financial burden
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Legally rigorous, strategic, executive dignity, statutory citations

audience_cohorts.name: Gig Workers & Independent Contractors
core_fears: Clients ghosting on signed milestone invoices
No formal PF or corporate labor court access
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Pragmatic, contractual enforcement, debt recovery protocols

accounts.name: SaveSmart FinTech
accounts.mission: Making automated investing, emergency fund discipline, and debt relief accessible to young professionals and families through modern smart tooling.
tone_rules: Clear, optimistic, mathematically grounded, reassuring, educational
Make complex financial concepts intuitive with simple daily analogies
Encourage calm, automated habits over get-rich-quick speculation
forbidden_terms: Shaming individuals for low income or past debt
mandatory_disclaimers: Investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme-related documents carefully before investing.

audience_cohorts.name: First-Time Earners & Gen-Z (21-25 yrs)
core_fears: Credit card debt traps
FOMO and paycheck-to-paycheck anxiety
Feeling intimidated by confusing mutual fund terminology
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Relatable, bite-sized, gamified savings, micro-budgeting tips

audience_cohorts.name: Young Working Couples & Home Planners (26-35 yrs)
core_fears: Inflation eroding savings
Balancing home downpayment with emergency funds
Tax leakages

accounts.name: Alex Vance | Tech CEO
accounts.mission: Sharing honest, behind-the-scenes insights on scaling AI tech companies, leading high-performance engineering cultures, and navigating executive career inflection points.
tone_rules: Speak from first-person lived experience; candidly highlight failures and pivots
Zero corporate jargon or performative hustle culture clichés

audience_cohorts.name: Early-Stage Founders & Tech Builders
core_fears: Failing to find product-market fit (PMF)
Running out of runway before closing next round
Hiring the wrong senior leaders
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Direct, empathetic to founder loneliness, tactical playbooks

audience_cohorts.name: Senior Engineers & Engineering Managers
core_fears: Career plateauing at senior engineer level
Struggling with cross-functional leadership and business communication
Burnout in high-pressure delivery cycles
audience_cohorts.tone_resonance: Peer-to-peer respect, high agency, systemic thinking
